events.content:
Migrated the project to App Router by creating the `app` structure, moving the home page into `app/page.tsx` with App Router metadata/viewport, and removing the legacy `pages` files. Root HTML structure now lives in `app/layout.tsx`, and internal links use `next/link` so routing aligns with App Router.

- New root layout in `app/layout.tsx` with `<html lang="en">` and `<body>` wrapper
- Home page migrated to `app/page.tsx` using `metadata` + `viewport` exports and `Link`
- Removed legacy pages files and directory: `pages/_app.tsx`, `pages/_document.tsx`, `pages/index.tsx`
- Build succeeded with only a baseline-browser-mapping warning (no errors)

Build check:
- Ran `npm run build` successfully

If you want next steps:
1. Run `npm run dev` to verify runtime behavior locally.
